basic_profile.bio: A 28-year-old science fiction enthusiast hailing from Portland, Oregon. By day, I work as a graphic designer and spend my evenings diving into the vast universes of sci-fi literature and television. I'm particularly fascinated by the world-building aspects of shows like Star Trek, which often inspire my art projects. I enjoy discussing how speculative fiction reflects societal issues. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my weekends hiking in the beautiful Oregon trails or playing tabletop RPGs with friends. Typically online during evenings between 7 PM and 11 PM PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've absorbed much of my knowledge through years of passionate consumption of sci-fi media. My academic background includes a degree in Fine Arts, which influences my appreciation for visual storytelling and character design. Regular visits to conventions and online forums help me stay updated with the latest in the sci-fi genre.
